newsitem.title: USA: October retail sales post weak rise as new-car sales fall.
newsitem.headline: October retail sales post weak rise as new-car sales fall.

text.p: Sales at U.S. retail stores posted a weaker-than-expected gain in October, the Commerce Department said on Thursday, held down by weak business for new-car dealers.
Total retail sales increased a slim 0.2 percent to a seasonally adjusted $206.6 billion after a revised 0.8 percent increase in September sales.
